remarks: Great location! Available immediately! Welcome home to this bright, versatile & well-maintained 3-beds, 2-baths duplex, just steps from Pemberwick Park in the Glenville School District. Main level features an inviting living room & dining room, office or play area. Eat-In kitchen w/ss appliances & quartz countertop. Upstairs, you will find 2 comfortable bedrooms & full bath. Updated LL offers 3rd bedroom w/large walk-in closet, 2nd full bath, spacious playroom for flexible living, plus washer/dryer and plenty of storage. Hardwood floors. Enjoy a great backyard with covered porch, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, with convenient off-street parking and plenty of on street parking. This home offers comfort, functionality and a fantastic location-ideal for today's lifestyle.
